subject: romanian
summary: Romanian is in reasonable shape. Questions are clear, Romanian letters render correctly, and the attached reading text is the right one and opens on the passage with no other questions on its first page. The essay and commentary cards are the best of any language deck sampled because they show the scheme's four marking criteria with their percentage weights and a mark picker for each. The main fault is the 2012 commentary card, where about 25 lines of sample-answer quotations and editorial remarks are poured into one small grey paragraph above the criteria. The one-mark vocabulary cards bury the phrase to be explained at the end of a long instruction sentence.

issues.title: Wall of small grey text in the commentary scheme
issues.detail: Between the bold description and the four criteria there is a single grey paragraph that mixes the answer-in-Romanian rule, a remark that 'The scheme prints, as examples, not a checklist', and three long quoted sample answers separated only by semicolons. It is about 30 lines of small grey type on the phone and 19 on desktop, and the phone card runs to well over two screens before the first mark picker appears. The sample answers are the most useful part and are the hardest to read.
issues.suggested_fix: Show the three sample answers as separate, normal-size paragraphs under a heading 'Example answers from the scheme', collapsed by default on the phone. Keep the language rule to one short line.

issues.title: Phrase to explain is buried in the instruction
issues.detail: The one-mark vocabulary cards print the shared instruction and the target phrase as one sentence: 'Explicați pe scurt următoarele cuvinte și expresii (redate îngroșat în text), folosind sinonime ... în care apar: pasul decisiv'. The phrase is not set apart or emphasised, and the instruction still says 'the following words and expressions' (plural) though the card asks for one.
issues.suggested_fix: Put the instruction in the smaller stem line and show the phrase on its own line in bold or quotation marks.

issues.title: Mark pickers hard to relate to the percentages
issues.detail: Criteria are labelled '30%', '30%', '30%', '10%' while the pickers run 0-9, 0-9, 0-9, 0-3 (card 1) or 0-12 and 0-4 (card 5). The student has to work out that 30% of 30 is 9. The heading above says 'Select the points you actually got', which does not describe picking a mark per criterion.
issues.suggested_fix: Add 'out of 9' / 'out of 12' beside each criterion and change the heading to 'Mark yourself on each criterion'.

issues.title: Grey language note attached to the answer box
issues.detail: Each scheme box carries a grey note quoting the paper's answer-in-Romanian rule, three to six lines on the phone, and on card 4 also 'The scheme heads it: ...'. On the one-mark cards the note is nearly as long as the answer.
issues.suggested_fix: State the rule once, outside the tick boxes, in one short line.

issues.title: Attachment label and empty band
issues.detail: Card 1 labels the passage 'READ PARTEA II' though the page is the Part I reading text the question refers to as 'text (p.1)'. On the phone every card has a blank band of about 200 pixels between the attachment button and the answer box.
issues.suggested_fix: Label the button 'Read the passage'; collapse the gap.
